subject: Wardrobes for sloped ceilings and alcoves
hook: Happy Christmas from the Hanley workshop
gbp:
Happy Christmas from all of us at SUPERIO Furniture.

Thank you to everyone in Leek and across Staffordshire who has followed, asked questions and talked furniture with us this year. We hope you get a proper rest and a house full of good company.

If, while everyone is staying over, you notice a spare room with no wardrobe space or a loft bedroom where the clothes live on a chair, keep a note. Sloped ceilings and chimney alcoves are exactly where made-to-measure wardrobes make the biggest difference. We design them to follow the slope, with long hanging where the ceiling is tallest and drawers where it drops, and scribe them to uneven walls so they look built in.

In the new year we can start with a free, no-obligation design consultation and an itemised quote. Everything is built in our own Hanley workshop and fitted by our own team.

For now, enjoy Christmas.
cta: Enjoy Christmas; learn more when you are ready
